text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS141, Starfish Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

The Nickel Silver Standard Starfish Door Knocker is great for any coastal home. Its detailing making it not only a piece of art, but a classy way to bring the feel of the beach right to your front door. The Starfish Front Door Knocker in Nickel Silver has a 1-1/2 inch mounting center and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also Available: larger 6-1/2" Nickel Silver Starfish Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Nickel Silver Starfish Standard Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 5"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-7/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 2 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass and Bronze

Sold Individually
